text_block_list.text:
On our way back from training with Oguri 
Cap, we spotted a crying child and Tamamo 
Cross comforting them.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! A dog or two, I'll track 
'em down in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what happened.

According to the children, a dog ran off 
into the woods while on a walk, and Tamamo 
Cross went searching for it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The sun is setting. The forest is 
dangerous at night. I'm going to go help, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My thanks. Now, let us hurry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are footprints. Fresh ones... It's 
probably Tama. Let's follow them.
choice_data_list: We need to leave a marker.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Not needed. There's a tree. That can be 
our landmark.

Oguri Cap marches forward without 
hesitation. Though a bit uneasy, I 
followed behind to avoid losing her. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aw man... I found the dog, but now I'm 
completely lost. At this rate, they're 
gonna be searchin' for me right along with 
the dog.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ya go callin' me stuff like 'Wan-chan' 
or 'Tama-chan,' don't that make me sound 
totally like a cat?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Please answer with a 'Meow'~"—Wait, what 
kind of gag is that?! I'm an Umamusume, ya 
know!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! O-Oguri and Trainer?! Say something 
if you're here!

A dog was sitting by Tamamo Cross's feet. 
I asked about the situation and explained 
that I had been following after her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So, are you guys lost too? Man, sorry to 
hear that."
choice_data_list: Actually, Oguri Cap showed me the way...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That's no good. Oguri gets lost all the 
time, both at the academy and in town."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped. This dog is friendly, but 
not dependable, so I gotta find a way out 
of the forest myself—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Understood. This way.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! Why are YOU the one taking the 
lead?! We're just gonna get even more 
lost!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"These trees, the bushes, and the feel of 
the soil... There's no doubt this is the 
path I took earlier. It's this way."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's too dark to see footprints, but... 
this tree trunk, I saw it earlier. We turn 
here next.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!? Aren't you looking dependable...! 
Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Don't worry, leave it to me. I'll 
guide you properly.

Following Oguri Cap, whose face was full 
of confidence—

Astonishingly, we reached the forest exit 
without losing our way even once!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I made it in! For real?! Way to go, 
Oguri!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The shapes of trees and bushes, and even 
how the dirt feels, are different 
everywhere. It's way easier to navigate 
than a city.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, that really helped! Much 
obliged! Turns out Oguri can do it when 
she sets her mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing special. No big deal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't be so modest! Anyway, you were 
a huge help! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Was I able to be of help to Tama and 
Trainer? ...This might be the first time 
I've ever felt this way.
choice_data_list: You're always saving the day for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I thought I was just on the 
receiving end, but... I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I managed to repay the favor without 
even realizing it, then all the better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'll keep devoting myself to 
repaying this debt of gratitude, so let me 
know if there's anything I can do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Relying on... I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are ways people can rely on 
me other than running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I'm glad. Don't hesitate to rely 
on me anytime."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm countin' on ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right then, let's go return the dog! 
Their house is near the station, so from 
here—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This way, then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where do ya think you're goin'?! 
That's the wrong way!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh, this way then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's the complete opposite! Why did ya get 
lost here instead of in the forest?!

Afterward, guided by Tamamo Cross, we were 
able to safely deliver the dog to the 
child's home.
